scope: Isolated browser; real local PDF/XLSX libraries, generated files kept in memory and simulated export markers. No live services.
checks: Opening the board requests neither the Excel nor PDF export library
Concurrent callers share one PDF request and create a valid PDF
The lazy Excel library writes and reads a genuine workbook
A blocked PDF dependency returns an actionable error and removes its script
The next PDF request can recover immediately
CSV export remains available without loading Excel and marks only after file creation
Waiting for Excel keeps duplicate exports disabled and sends no premature mark
Disposing the workspace while its dependency is pending prevents a late download or mark
A dependency failure releases the export controls without marking or creating a file
Retry loads Excel and creates exactly one workbook and one export mark
Library and workspace checks produce no uncaught browser errors
